QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_37

question.text: Running account settlement of client funds lying with Trading Members must be done:

answer.text: On a monthly or quarterly basis as mandated/chosen by the client, on dates stipulated by stock exchanges, with exchanges jointly issuing the annual calendar
Only at the end of the financial year
Only when the client requests withdrawal
No settlement is required — funds can be retained indefinitely

explanation.text: The Logic: Running accounts of client funds are settled on a monthly or quarterly basis as per the mandate or choice of the client, on dates stipulated by stock exchanges. Stock exchanges jointly issue the annual running-account settlement calendar. The Trap: Settlement is not limited to year-end, is not contingent only on a withdrawal request, and indefinite retention of client funds is not permitted. Note: The client mandate selects monthly or quarterly periodicity; the dates themselves follow the exchange-issued annual calendar.
